config.description: M1 v1.2 real-device config for DEV112P 1dfft recordings (pilot: T01/P01/R01, 5.168 Hz, region [1,3] signal-calibrated, main_bin 2). Fixes the v1.1 EMA-absorption coupling measured on P01: alpha=0.2 absorbs a static entrant (time constant ~1 s; still occupant detected only after 72 s) while alpha=0.02 lags drift (empty segment becomes whole-recording FP). background.mode=snapshot_freeze accumulates a running mean over the first 50 frames (9.7 s; protocol requires an empty-seat prefix, P01 has 19.7 s), freezes on first confirmed occupancy and stays frozen through occupancy; after a confirmed release, 90 evidence-empty frames (score <= t_off; hysteresis crests neither count nor reset) trigger a rebuild, and rebuild accumulation only absorbs evidence-empty frames so a quickly returning occupant is never absorbed (partial K_eff freeze on re-confirm keeps a clean-empty snapshot). f1_bins=non_main: F1 is the residual power over region bins EXCLUDING main_bin (on this hardware the 0.33 Hz environmental disturbance concentrates on main bin 2; bins 1/3 carry the occupant). f1_db_map=[30,43.5] is open-loop calibrated against the frozen K=50 snapshot on P01 (empty P99 36.01 dB, occupant P50 43.04 dB, settled-entry P10 38.76 dB -> T_ON crossing 37.59 dB, +1.58 dB over empty P99). Closed-loop P01: empty FP 0/102, entry confirmed 4.45 s after the baseline edge, full hold through the 74-frame posture 'valley' (a ratio-artifact; absolute F1 stays high), zero 1->0 transitions. Known limitations (see outputs/t01-p01/): recording must start empty for >= snapshot_frames; entry settling (first ~1.3 s) sits at empty-residual level -> ~4.5 s confirm latency; static gate inert (env disturbance inflates f23 when empty); drift-defeated release on long empty tails mitigated but not eliminated by the evidence-empty rebuild.
config.background_rationale: snapshot_frames=50 (9.7 s at 5.168 Hz) fits inside P01's 19.7 s empty prefix; re_snapshot_confirm=90 (17.4 s) exceeds the sum of initial-empty counter carry-over and entry-settling weak frames (~63 on P01) so an unsettled entrant can never trigger a rebuild; accumulation and rebuild counting are both gated on score <= t_off so unconfirmed-return frames never enter the snapshot.
config.target_count_policy: 1 when presence=1 (single-seat region assumption, documented), 0 when empty, -1 when unknown

region_params.note: Nominal installation values from project plan 5.2 (24-24.25 GHz sweep -> 0.6 m resolution). Replace with measured values after real installation. Coarse-granularity risk documented: plan A region spans only ~3-4 bins.
region_params.bin_conversion: bin_lo = floor(region_m[0] / range_resolution_m); bin_hi = ceil(region_m[1] / range_resolution_m); clip to [0, n_range_bins-1]
